answer: The cheapest real defence: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ivory only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, ferrous is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any oasis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
